metadata.title: Aiwan-e-Zaiqa Food Festival 2023 co-curated by Delhi Food Walks l Panchayat series ke Parmeshwar Ji
metadata.description:
Jashn-e-Rekhta is a three-day festival that celebrates all facets of Urdu language through various art forms.

In 2023, Delhi Food Walks had the privilege of co-curating the Aiwan-e-Zaiqa food court at this coveted event for the fifth time and it turned out to be one of its main attractions. 

It was a delightful showcase of handpicked dishes and extraordinary flavors from diverse regions, both within the country and beyond.
